newsitem.title: USA: Superior Bank files $1 bln asset backed certs.
newsitem.headline: Superior Bank files $1 bln asset backed certs.

text.p: Superior Bank FSB filed on Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a shelf offering of up to $1 billion in AFC Mortgage Loan Asset Backed Certificates.

Superior, based in Oakbrook Terrace, Ill., and acquired by Coast to Coast Financial Corp. on Dec. 31, 1988, said the filing is in addition to $120,240,872.08 of AFC Mortgage Loan Asset Backed Certificates previously registered but not previously sold.
Proceeds from the offering will be used to repay, or buy short-term loans incurred to originate or finance purchase of, mortgage loans or for general corporate purpoes, Superior said.
The company did not name underwriters for the offering.
